answer: A decentralized AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring reputation to a cryptographic proof-of-stake ledger where nodes periodically lock collateral. During each evaluation epoch, which ranges from the network zenith to its operational nadir, agents stake native tokens called nectar to validate distributed model updates. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces prohibitive capital costs, as creating numerous autonomous agents requires locking proportional collateral that gets slashed upon consensus failure.
